import numpy as np, json
def f(I):
    I=np.array(I)
    ic=Counter(I.flat); bc=ic.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # marker color: exactly 4 cells forming rectangle corners, bbox must contain other objects
    for c,v in sorted(ic.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1]):
        if c==bc or v!=4: continue
        pts=list(map(tuple,np.argwhere(I==c)))
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        corners={(min(rs),min(cs)),(min(rs),max(cs)),(max(rs),min(cs)),(max(rs),max(cs))}
        if set(pts)==corners and max(rs)-min(rs)>=2 and max(cs)-min(cs)>=2:
            m=c; break
    else: m=None
    assert m is not None
    ms=set(pts)
    dr0=min(p[0] for p in ms); dc0=min(p[1] for p in ms)
    h=max(p[0] for p in ms)-dr0+1; w=max(p[1] for p in ms)-dc0+1
    out=I[dr0:dr0+h,dc0:dc0+w].copy()
    inside_colors={int(I[r,c]) for r in range(dr0,dr0+h) for c in range(dc0,dc0+w) if I[r,c]!=bc and I[r,c]!=m}
    cl=[(r,c,int(I[r,c])) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for c in range(I.shape[1])
        if I[r,c]!=bc and I[r,c]!=m and (r,c) not in ms]
    anchors=[(r,c,col) for r,c,col in cl if col in inside_colors]
    ar,c_,acol=anchors[0]
    incells=[(r,c) for r in range(dr0,dr0+h) for c in range(dc0,dc0+w) if I[r,c]==acol]
    tr,tc_=min(incells,key=lambda p:abs(ar-p[0])+abs(c_-p[1]))
    sr,sc_=tr-ar,tc_-c_
    for r,c,col in cl:
        nr,nc=r+sr,c+sc_
        if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w:
            out[nr,nc]=col
    return out.tolist()
allok=True
for k in (1,2,3,4):
    got=f(G[f'Demo pair {k} input']); exp=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    m=got==exp; allok&=m
    print(k,m)
    if not m:
        g=np.array(got);e=np.array(exp)
        print(sorted(map(tuple,np.argwhere(g!=e))))
print('ALL',allok)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))

def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape
    cnt=Counter(I.flat)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # frame markers: 4-corner value v with min count==4 and distinct corners
    marks=[c for c,v in cnt.items() if v==4 and c!=bg]
    if len(marks)!=1: return None
    m=marks[0]
    pts=list(np.argwhere(I==m))
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    out=I[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1].copy()
    h,w=out.shape
    ins={(r,c,int(I[r,c])) for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in range(c0,c1+1) if I[r,c]!=m and I[r,c]!=bg}
    cl=[tuple(z) for z in np.argwhere((I!=bg)&(I!=m)&(I[:,None,:]!=np.arange(H)[:,None])|True)]
    # proper: outside cells = nonzero-non-bg-non-mark anywhere
    outside=[(int(p[0]),int(p[1]),int(I[p])) for p in np.argwhere((I!=bg)&(I!=m)) if not (r0<=p[0]<=r1 and c0<=p[1]<=c1)]
    # group outside cells into connected components (4-conn), ignore singles that are noise? keep all clusters
    comps=[]; seen=set(); pts_set={(int(r),int(c)) for r,c,_ in outside}
    for p in list(pts_set):
        if p in seen: continue
        stack=[p]; comp=[]
        seen.add(p)
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop(); comp.append((r,c))
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if n in pts_set and n not in seen:
                    seen.add(n); stack.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    return comps,ins,out,bg,m,pts

def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I)
    cnt=Counter(int(x) for x in I.flat)
    bg=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    # frame markers: color with exactly 4 cells forming perfect rectangle corners
    cands=[]
    for m,v in cnt.items():
        if v!=4 or m==bg: continue
        pts=[(int(a),int(b)) for a,b in np.argwhere(I==m)]
        rs={p[0] for p in pts}; cs={p[1] for p in pts}
        corners={(min(rs),min(cs)),(min(rs),max(cs)),(max(rs),min(cs)),(max(rs),max(cs))}
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2 and set(pts)==corners:
            span=max(max(rs)-min(rs),max(cs)-min(cs))
            cands.append((span,m,corners))
    best=min(cands)[1:]  # (color, corners)
    r0=min(p[0] for p in best[1]); r1=max(p[0] for p in best[1])
    c0=min(p[1] for p in best[1]); c1=max(p[1] for p in best[1])
    out=I[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1].copy()
    outside=[(int(a),int(b),int(I[a,b])) for a,b in np.argwhere((I!=bg)&(I!=best[0]))
             if not (r0<=a<=r1 and c0<=b<=c1)]
    return out,outside

for i in (1,2,3,4):
    Ii=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); Oi=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    out,cl=solve(Ii)
    print(i,'out',out.shape,'Oi',Oi.shape,'match',np.array_equal(out,Oi),'outside:',cl)

    cands=[]
    for m,v in cnt.items():
        if v!=4 or m==bg: continue
        pts=[(int(a),int(b)) for a,b in np.argwhere(I==m)]
        rs={p[0] for p in pts}; cs={p[1] for p in pts}
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2 and set(pts)=={(min(rs),min(cs)),(min(rs),max(cs)),(max(rs),min(cs)),(max(rs),max(cs))}:
            cands.append((m,min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    m,r0,r1,c0,c1=cands[0]
    out=I[r0:r1+1,c0:c1+1].copy()
    h,w=out.shape
    ins={(a-r0,b-c0) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1)
         if int(I[a,b]) not in (m,bg)}
    # outside cells connected to each other
    outs=[(a,b,int(I[a,b])) for a in range(I.shape[0]) for b in range(I.shape[1])

    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in {(a,b) for a,b,_ in outs}:
        if p in seen: continue
        q=deque([p]); comp=[]; seen.add(p)
        while q:
            r,c=q.popleft(); comp.append((r,c))
            for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(r+dr,c+dc)
                if (n[0],n[1]) in {(a,b) for a,b,_ in outs} and n not in seen:

        comps.append(comp)
    best=None
    for comp in comps:

        else: continue
        if cv in [{v:{(a-r0,b-c0) for a in range(r0,r1+1) for b in range(c0,c1+1) if int(I[a,b])==v} for v in {}][set(outs)], False]: break

    bg=max(Counter(x for r in g for x in r),key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in g))
    # frame = largest solid-border rectangle of non-bg color
    best=None
    for i1 in range(H):
        for j1 in range(W):
            c=g[i1][j1]
            if c==bg: continue
            for h in range(3,H-i1+1):
                for w in range(3,W-j1+1):
                    sub=[row[j1:j1+w] for row in g[i1:i1+h]]
                    ok=all(len(set(row))==1 and row[0]==c for row in sub[:1]+sub[-1:]) or all(sub[r][0]==c and sub[r][-1]==c for r in range(h))
                    border_ok = all((all(x==c for x in row) or all(x!=c for x in row)) for row in [sub[0],sub[-1]]) \
                         and all(sub[0][j]==c or sub[-1][j]==c or True for j in range(w)) \
                         and all(all(sub[r][j]==c or sub[r][j]==g[i1][j1] or True for j in range(w)) for r in range(h))

                        area=h*w
                        if best is None or area>best[0]: best=(area,i1,j1,h,w,c)
    _,i1,j1,h,w,c=best

def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=max(Counter(x for r in g for x in r),key=lambda c:sum(r.count(c) for r in g))
    # find frame: 4 same-color corners of rectangle, color != bg
    from collections import defaultdict as dd
    best=None
    for c in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg}:
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==c]
        if len(pts)!=4: continue
        rows=sorted(set(i for i,j in pts)); cols=sorted(set(j for i,j in pts))
        if len(rows)!=2 or len(cols)!=2: continue
        (r1,c1),(r1,c2),(r2,c1),(r2,c2)=[p for p in pts]
        area=(r2-r1)*(c2-c1)
        if best is None or area>best[0]: best=(area,r1,c1,r2,c2,c)
    _,r1,c1,r2,c2,fc=best
    crop=[[g[r][k] for k in range(c1,c2+1)] for r in range(r1,r2+1)]
    return crop,fc,(r2-r1)//2,(c2-c1)//2,bg
